description: This source file defines the Android activity 'Connectivity' used for testing network connectivity, managing Wi-Fi and Ethernet interfaces, performing scans, and testing network requests within an Android development environment.

classes.name: DevToolsNetworkCallback
classes.description: A custom NetworkCallback for monitoring network events, such as network availability, capabilities changes, link properties updates, and disconnections.

classes.name: RequestableNetwork
classes.description: Class representing a network request with methods to request and release the network, and manage UI state.

classes.name: DevToolsEthListener
classes.description: Listener class for Ethernet interface state changes, handling interface state and role changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, register receivers, and network callbacks.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the activity by unregistering receivers and callbacks, and releasing resources.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume events, focusing the layout.

methods.name: onStartDelayedCycle
methods.description: Begins a delayed Wi-Fi toggle cycle with wake lock and alarm scheduling.

methods.name: onStopDelayedCycle
methods.description: Stops the ongoing delayed Wi-Fi toggle cycle.

methods.name: onStartScreenCycle
methods.description: Starts a screen power cycle with wake locks and alarm scheduling.

methods.name: scheduleAlarm
methods.description: Schedules an alarm for toggling screen states after specified delays.

methods.name: onStopScreenCycle
methods.description: Stops the screen power cycle (empty implementation).

methods.name: onReportAllBad
methods.description: Reports all networks as bad to the system.

methods.name: onStartScanCycle
methods.description: Starts or stops Wi-Fi scan cycles, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: onStartTdls
methods.description: Enables TDLS (Tunneled Direct Link Setup) to a specified MAC or IP address.

methods.name: onStopTdls
methods.description: Disables TDLS to the specified MAC or IP address.

methods.name: onLinkStats
methods.description: Fetches and displays Wi-Fi energy info asynchronously.

methods.name: onHttpRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP or socket request via a specified network, in a separate thread.

methods.name: doSocketRequest
methods.description: Performs a raw socket HTTP request to the specified host and path, returning the first line of response.

methods.name: onHttpRequestResults
methods.description: Updates the UI with the HTTP request results.

methods.name: onWifiMulticastLock
methods.description: Enables or disables Wifi multicast lock.
